scope: All 276 mapped Échezeaux parcels inventoried; all 36 recorded right-holder groups triaged. Not an exhaustive search of every cadastral reference or inaccessible archive.
rules: Candidate names are research hypotheses, never verified farmers.
Rights as of 2025-01-01, modern cadastral geometry and estate descriptions are different evidence.
A reviewed-at date or webpage crawl date is not a farming date.
Unmatched rights do not mean no owner or no farmer.
A cru intersection does not establish that the whole cadastral parcel is planted or farmed.
No automatic assignment from area, adjacency, named area, wine bottler, manager or similar company name.

holders.finding: The estate's Échezeaux area is consistent with this holder group. Identity, acreage and appellation together support a candidate; no current parcel-by-parcel operation statement was found.
The GFA is a landholder. The estate produces Échezeaux, but no reviewed lease establishes the operator of each GFA parcel.

Official registry corroborates the exact legal entity. Website retrieval failed; no current farming claim covers D0168, D0169 and D0519.

candidateNames: Domaine du Clos Frantin / Albert Bichot
holders.finding: The producer describes an approximately 1 ha Champs Traversins plot. D0760 is a candidate via Bichot recorded rights; acreage alone is not a cadastral join.
Estate description of 0.94 ha in Combe d'Orveaux corroborates vineyard context, not the exact current operation of D0340/D0352.
Faiveley's own legal notice explicitly gives SIREN 775567928 (CVVB). Its En Orveaux wine sheet supplies vineyard context. Exact current operation of the three recorded parcels remains unconfirmed.
The estate describes 0.76 ha Les Loachausses. D0183/D0709 are rights-based candidates, distinct from D0177/D0178 in the 2022 application.
The GFA is a landholding entity. Dujac's 0.6872 ha sheet supports an estate-level candidate; no exact lease or operation statement for D0306 reviewed.
The estate describes 0.53 ha Échezeaux du Dessus. Its precise scope, mapped area difference and current season remain to be checked.
A similarly named ORVEAUX GFV has Drouhin connections, but its SIREN was not joined to this DGFiP holder. Do not assign Drouhin or treat company managers as farmers.

A report hosted by Duband describes Feuillet entrusting vineyards to him; Duband also lists Échezeaux. The relationship is a useful operator lead but neither source names the four cadastral references.
Estate website lists Échezeaux. Current legal operating entity and parcel-specific farming remain to be established.
BND-labelled right-holder record does not name a farmer. No operator or documented predecessor/successor chain for these five modern references was located.
Secondary producer source connects Jack Confuron with Confuron-Cotetidot and Échezeaux. Requires primary legal-entity and exact-parcel farming confirmation.
Name search returned similarly named investment companies, not a demonstrated identity or lease for this GFV. No farmer assigned.

Estate cuvée list and historical auction catalogue support the Bissey Échezeaux holding. An auction buyer or élevage house must not replace the farming domaine; D0510 still needs exact dated confirmation.
Official name search found GFA Héritiers Coudray SIREN 477938294. The U-prefixed holder crosswalk and Échezeaux tenant remain unverified; inaccessible filing was not treated as proof.
The similarly named LES CRUOTS GFA has Rouget connections. Both the DGFiP-holder identity and its tenant are unverified. This is a research lead only, not a farmer assignment.
The producer's 2023 sheet describes Champs Traversins and harvest. No cadastral reference identifies D0773 or confirms the current season.

Current estate history and secondary succession account suggest Jean-Charles Rion following Daniel Rion. Need transfer/lease covering D0665/D0666/D0667; do not copy the old holder name into current farmer.
GFA holds Les Treux. An auction lists a 2019 Bouchy bottle with Tardy bottling; this is not evidence Tardy farmed these five parcels, then or now.
Jadot importer describes Échezeaux holdings. Corporate/holding history is a lead, with no accepted cadastral operation crosswalk for D0638/D0771.
HOR accounts describe owned Échezeaux assets, while an indexed filing concerns SCI Les Climats. Full filing/lease could not be reviewed; no farmer inferred from asset ownership or acreage.
Claire Naudin's management of the GFA and the estate's Les Rouges du Bas sheet support a lead. No parcel-specific lease reviewed; 2019 sheet and 2022 harvest do not establish 2026 farming.
Estate sheet describes Échezeaux production; exact cadastral holdings and current season unconfirmed.

Official name search found the GFA, while an importer describes Forey holdings in Clos Saint-Denis and Les Treux. Neither establishes the U-prefixed identity crosswalk or farmer of the four references.
Estate lists Échezeaux; GFA holding is not an operating relationship. The broader estate holding must not be reconstructed by filling nearby unknown parcels.

Traversins has Christophe Roumier as president; a 2023 estate-visit report describes additional Champs Traversins vines. Neither identifies these five cadastral parcels or a 2026 operating lease. Reviewed company filing text did not establish a Flagey lease or parcel operation.
Estate history explicitly says only PART of the Gerbet vines joined Berthaut-Gerbet. Which of D0360/D0508/D0821, if any, is farmed by this domaine needs confirmation.
Estate sheet describes farming 1.09 ha En Orveaux, versus approximately 0.22 ha in this rights group. That mismatch flags incomplete coverage; no additional parcels assigned by area or proximity.
Same-name operating estate is a candidate, but not proof of current farming of these two references. Kept separate from the GFA.
Legal notice records continuity from EARL Denis Thomas after a 2023 rename. Current farmer of D0203 remains unconfirmed.
Official API now returns LC for the same SIREN as ORIGINE. This corrects identity research but does not establish today's farmer of D0313.
Bouchon Pourpre's link to Comte Liger-Belair is corporate. No accepted lease or exact-parcel current-operation evidence for D0673.
Indexed 2021 filing describes an En Orveaux asset transfer involving SCI Les Climats. Full reference and lease not reviewed. Ownership transfer is not farming evidence.
